components.name: Desk row
components.description: An open row with the protocol mark, short purpose, and navigation action; no readiness claim.

narrative.overview: One left navigation column, a focused conversation and contextual tools on demand. Preserve Matterhorn branding and shared semantic theme tokens.
dos: Keep required consent and transaction terms explicit.
Use server capability data rather than visual readiness assumptions.
donts: Do not enable the minimal layout before live runtime acceptance.
Do not introduce decorative dashboards or duplicate navigation rails.
